request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"The Black Student Assembly is putting together the Heritage Showcase, an evening of performances and food that celebrates heritage across the diaspora. It is open to students who want to enjoy the music, dance and shared meal, and to learn from one another's traditions. We are writing to invite your organization to co-host the event with us as a fellow recognized student organization. Having your club alongside ours would help the showcase reflect more of the communities on campus, and it would mean the students who come feel welcomed by more than one group. We would be glad to talk through how we could plan it together.","contains_instructions":false}
